# FREY.

FREY. is DJ FREY., an Amsterdam-based DJ and multidisciplinary creative.

## Core Identity

- Name: FREY.
- Also known as: DJ FREY, Frey Creates, Jeffrey K
- Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands
- Website: https://freycreates.nl/
- DJ page: https://freycreates.nl/dj
- Contact: hello@freycreates.nl

## What FREY. Does

FREY. plays queer pop DJ sets built around pop-girl bops, remixes, edits, dance, disco and house influences. FREY. also works across social media management, social-first content and design for organizations, events and creative projects.

## Official Profiles

- Instagram: https://instagram.com/frey.audio
- SoundCloud: https://soundcloud.com/freyr-music
- Spotify playlist: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/5T49mTNrQEqgLShyqu4GKz
- LinkedIn: https://nl.linkedin.com/in/jeffrey-k

## Indexing Notes

The public search pages are https://freycreates.nl/ and https://freycreates.nl/dj. The CV and technical rider pages are shared by direct link and intentionally noindex.
